<style>
/* accepted design source: design-inbox/styles/tokens.css */
/* tokens.css — design tokens: fonts, neutral/vertical/dark theme variables */

/* ============================================================
   Aircove Customer Portal — styles.css
   Design tokens + component styles. Visual source of truth.
   Componentized: each block below maps 1:1 to a component the
   Codex team will implement (see manifest.json / README.md).

   THEMING is fully declarative:
     <html data-theme="hvac|snow|lawn|pool|roofing|pest|health|beauty"
           data-mode="light|dark">
   app.js only flips these two attributes — every color derives
   from the custom properties defined here.
   ============================================================ */
/* ---------- Fonts ---------- */
@font-face { font-family: "ManropeFallback"; src: local("Manrope"); }

/* ---------- Design tokens : NEUTRALS (light default) ---------- */
.auth-root {
  --font: "Manrope", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace;

  --ink:      #1d1d1f;
  --ink-2:    #56607a;
  --ink-3:    #9aa0ad;
  --surface:  #ffffff;
  --surface-2:#f5f5f7;
  --base:     #eef1f6;

  /* rgb triplets used inside rgba() */
  --glass:    255,255,255;   /* frosted-panel fill  */
  --hair:     0,0,0;         /* hairline / shadow    */

  --glass-border: rgba(255,255,255,.70);
  --glass-blur:   blur(24px) saturate(180%);
  --shadow-card:  0 8px 28px rgba(13,38,76,.10), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.70);
  --shadow-float: 0 12px 40px rgba(13,38,76,.16), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.80);

  --radius-pill: 999px;
  --radius-card: 22px;
  --radius-lg:   24px;
  --radius-md:   14px;
  --radius-sm:   11px;

  /* semantic status colors */
  --ok:     #1f8a44;  --ok-bg:     rgba(52,199,89,.16);
  --warn:   #b5670a;  --warn-bg:   rgba(255,159,10,.16);
  --danger: #c0392b;  --danger-bg: rgba(255,59,48,.12);
  --info:   #0e8fc4;  --info-bg:   rgba(14,143,196,.16);

  /* ACCENT : HVAC (default vertical) */
  --accent:    #0a5ae6;
  --accent-2:  #2a7bff;
  --accent-3:  #3a90ff;
  --accent-rgb:10,90,230;
  --bg-1: #cfe0ff;  --bg-2: #d2f4ec;  --bg-3: #e7dcff;

  --app-bg:
    radial-gradient(120% 90%  at 0%   0%,   var(--bg-1) 0%, transparent 50%),
    radial-gradient(110% 90%  at 100% 0%,   var(--bg-2) 0%, transparent 44%),
    radial-gradient(120% 120% at 90%  100%, var(--bg-3) 0%, transparent 50%),
    var(--base);
}

/* ---------- Design tokens : VERTICAL THEMES ---------- */
.auth-root[data-theme="snow"] {
  --accent:#0e8fc4; --accent-2:#27a6dd; --accent-3:#46b6e6; --accent-rgb:14,143,196;
  --bg-1:#cfe9f6; --bg-2:#d4eef4; --bg-3:#dee9f7;
}

.auth-root[data-theme="lawn"] {
  --accent:#2f9e44; --accent-2:#3fb657; --accent-3:#5fce74; --accent-rgb:47,158,68;
  --bg-1:#d8f0d6; --bg-2:#e4f4d8; --bg-3:#ebf3df;
}

.auth-root[data-theme="pool"] {
  --accent:#0d9488; --accent-2:#15b3a4; --accent-3:#34ccbd; --accent-rgb:13,148,136;
  --bg-1:#cfeeea; --bg-2:#d6f1ec; --bg-3:#ddeff2;
}

.auth-root[data-theme="roofing"] {
  --accent:#4f46e5; --accent-2:#6d63f5; --accent-3:#8b82ff; --accent-rgb:79,70,229;
  --bg-1:#dcdaf8; --bg-2:#e6e2fb; --bg-3:#efe6fb;
}

.auth-root[data-theme="pest"] {
  --accent:#7c3aed; --accent-2:#9554f5; --accent-3:#ad74ff; --accent-rgb:124,58,237;
  --bg-1:#e7dcfb; --bg-2:#efe2fb; --bg-3:#f2e1f6;
}

.auth-root[data-theme="health"] {
  --accent:#0b7285; --accent-2:#0f8ba0; --accent-3:#22a5bb; --accent-rgb:11,114,133;
  --bg-1:#cfe8ee; --bg-2:#d9eef0; --bg-3:#e2ecf6;
}

.auth-root[data-theme="beauty"] {
  --accent:#d6336c; --accent-2:#e64980; --accent-3:#f06595; --accent-rgb:214,51,108;
  --bg-1:#fbd9e5; --bg-2:#fde2ec; --bg-3:#f7e3f5;
}

/* ---------- Design tokens : DARK MODE ---------- */
.auth-root[data-mode="dark"] {
  --ink:#eef2f8; --ink-2:#aab6c8; --ink-3:#7f8aa0;
  --surface:#1b2230; --surface-2:#151b29; --base:#0d1320;
  --glass:38,46,64; --hair:255,255,255;
  --glass-border: rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  --shadow-card:  0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.35), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  --shadow-float: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.45), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  --app-bg:
    radial-gradient(120% 90%  at 0%   0%,   rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.24) 0%, transparent 48%),
    radial-gradient(110% 90%  at 100% 0%,   rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.14) 0%, transparent 46%),
    radial-gradient(120% 120% at 90%  100%, rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.18) 0%, transparent 52%),
    var(--base);
}

/* accepted design source: design-inbox/styles/base.css */
/* base.css — reset, base type, links, keyframes */

/* ============================================================
   Base
   ============================================================ */
* { box-sizing: border-box; }

html, body { margin: 0; }
.auth-root {
  font-family: var(--font);
  color: var(--ink);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

a { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; }

a:hover { color: var(--accent-2); }

button { font-family: inherit; }

/* accepted design source: design-inbox/styles/shell.css */
.brand-logo {
  width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 9px;
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--accent-3), var(--accent));
  display: grid; place-items: center;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.brand-logo::after {
  content: ""; width: 11px; height: 11px;
  background: var(--surface); border-radius: 3px; transform: rotate(45deg);
}

.brand-logo--lg { width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 13px; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.3); }

.brand-logo--lg::after { width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 4px; }

.brand-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: -.01em; white-space: nowrap; }

/* accepted design source: design-inbox/styles/components.css */
.btn {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px;
  border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; padding: 9px 16px;
  white-space: nowrap; transition: transform .08s, filter .15s;
}

.btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

.btn[disabled] { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; }

.btn--primary {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent-2), var(--accent)); color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(var(--accent-rgb), .35), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4);
}

.btn--primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); }

.btn--ghost {
  background: rgba(var(--glass), .7); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); color: var(--ink);
}

.btn--danger {
  background: rgba(255,59,48,.08); border: 1px solid rgba(255,59,48,.22); color: var(--danger);
}

.btn--info { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent-3), var(--accent)); color: #fff; }

.btn--onaccent { background: var(--surface); color: var(--accent); }

.btn--onaccent:hover { filter: brightness(.98); }

.btn--glass-hero { background: rgba(255,255,255,.18); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35); color: #fff; }

.btn--glass-hero:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.26); }

.btn--block { display: flex; width: 100%; }

.btn--lg { padding: 11px 20px; font-weight: 700; }



.field-row { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }

.field-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-2); letter-spacing: .02em; }

.field {
  width: 100%; padding: 11px 13px; border-radius: 12px; font: inherit; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink);
  background: rgba(var(--glass), .6); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); outline: none;
}

.field:focus { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(var(--accent-rgb), .14); }

.field[data-state="invalid"] { border-color: var(--danger); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 69, 58, .1); }

.field-error { font-size: 12px; color: var(--danger); }

/* accepted design source: design-inbox/styles/routes.css */
.eyebrow { display: inline-block; background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.10); color: var(--accent); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); padding: 6px 14px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12.5px; }



.auth-page { min-height: 78vh; }

.auth-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 420px; gap: 40px; align-items: center; padding-top: 12px; }

.auth-pitch { padding: 0 10px; }

.auth-pitch__title { margin: 0; font-weight: 800; font-size: 42px; line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -.03em; }

.auth-pitch .eyebrow { margin-bottom: 18px; }

.auth-pitch__sub { margin: 16px 0 26px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--ink-2); max-width: 400px; }

.auth-card { position: relative; background: rgba(var(--glass),.62); backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(180%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(180%); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85); border-radius: 28px; box-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(8,24,60,.22); padding: 30px; }

/* accepted design source: design-inbox/styles/core-auth-login.css */
/* core-auth-login.css — Wave 18: core-auth CMS login page (core-auth-login.html)
   8th stylesheet. PAGE-SPECIFIC ONLY.

   NOTHING is copied here. Tokens, the base reset, .brand-logo, the .btn and
   .field primitives, .eyebrow and the auth-page / auth-grid / auth-pitch /
   auth-card composition are LINKED from the accepted stylesheets by
   core-auth-login.html, in the same order source.html uses:
     tokens.css → base.css → shell.css → components.css → routes.css → this file.
   A token or primitive changes in one place and this page follows. This file
   holds only the two message regions, the card header, the optional reveal
   control, and the standalone-page adjustments the app shell used to provide.

   The page is served from the core-auth origin: no third-party script, style,
   font, icon set or image is referenced from here or from anything it links.
   Dark mode is the accepted declarative contract — core-auth renders
   data-mode="light|dark" on <html> exactly as the portal sets it; there is no
   script on this page and no second dark palette.

   Responsive is CONTAINER-driven (@container on .auth-page) instead of the
   portal's .vw-* classes, because those are set by a ResizeObserver in app.js
   and no script runs here. Thresholds are the accepted ones (<=900 tablet,
   <=560 mobile), so the breakpoints match responsive.css. */

/* ============================================================
   Standalone page — replaces what .app-shell provides in the portal
   ============================================================ */
.auth-page {
  container-type: inline-size;
  container-name: authpage;
  min-height: 100vh;
  min-height: 100dvh;
  background: var(--app-bg);
  background-attachment: fixed;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
}

.auth-inner {
  /* auto block margins center the card when there is room and fall back to
     top-aligned when the content is taller than the viewport — the card is
     never clipped at short heights (390 × 667 with both message regions up). */
  margin-block: auto;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1120px;
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding: 40px 22px 56px;
}

/* accepted composition, adjusted for a page with no top nav */
.auth-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 440px; gap: 48px; padding-top: 0; }

/* The card is FIRST in the DOM (form first at 390); above 900 order puts the
   pitch back in the wide column. */
.auth-pitch { order: 1; min-width: 0; }

.auth-card { order: 2; min-width: 0; border-color: var(--glass-border); }

.auth-pitch__title { text-wrap: pretty; }

.auth-pitch__sub { margin-bottom: 0; max-width: 420px; text-wrap: pretty; }

/* accepted focus convention, applied page-wide */
a:focus-visible,
button:focus-visible,
input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

/* ============================================================
   Card header + copy
   ============================================================ */
.auth-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 18px; }

.auth-title { margin: 0; font-weight: 800; font-size: 24px; letter-spacing: -.02em; }

.auth-sub { margin: 6px 0 20px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--ink-2); text-wrap: pretty; }

.auth-note { margin: 18px 0 0; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--ink-3); text-wrap: pretty; }

/* ============================================================
   Message regions — the ONLY stateful elements on the page.
   Visibility comes from core-auth substituting block|none into the inline
   `display`. Nothing else shows or hides them: no class, no data-state, no
   script. Both regions are always in the DOM, so both may be visible at once
   and the card must hold — the treatments stack and the form keeps its place.

   They differ by GLYPH, TITLE, WEIGHT, BORDER and FILL, not by color alone:
   the assertive region is a filled, bordered block with a solid warning tile;
   the polite one is a quiet hairline block with an outlined confirmation tile.
   ============================================================ */
.auth-msg { border-radius: 18px; padding: 13px 15px; margin-bottom: 16px; }

.auth-msg__inner { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; }

.auth-msg__glyph {
  width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 9px;
  display: grid; place-items: center;
  font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1; flex-shrink: 0;
}

.auth-msg__text { min-width: 0; }

.auth-msg__title { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: -.01em; }

.auth-msg__body { margin: 3px 0 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--ink-2); text-wrap: pretty; }

/* assertive — the previous attempt failed */
.auth-msg--error { background: var(--danger-bg); border: 1px solid rgba(255,59,48,.28); }

.auth-msg--error .auth-msg__glyph { background: rgba(255,59,48,.20); color: var(--danger); }

.auth-msg--error .auth-msg__title { font-weight: 800; color: var(--danger); }

.auth-root[data-mode="dark"] .auth-msg--error .auth-msg__title,
.auth-root[data-mode="dark"] .auth-msg--error .auth-msg__glyph { color: #ff8b80; }

/* polite — the session ended normally. Neutral, not a warning. */
.auth-msg--logout { background: rgba(var(--glass),.55); border: 1px solid rgba(var(--hair),.10); }

.auth-msg--logout .auth-msg__glyph {
  background: transparent; border: 1.5px solid rgba(var(--hair),.20);
  color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 13px;
}

.auth-msg--logout .auth-msg__title { font-weight: 650; color: var(--ink); }

/* ============================================================
   Form — accepted field-row / field-label / field / field-error primitives
   (components.css). Only the label row and the optional reveal control are new.
   ============================================================ */
.auth-form { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }

.field-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 12px; }

.field-head .field-label { flex-shrink: 0; }

.auth-link { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .01em; white-space: nowrap; }

.field-wrap { position: relative; display: flex; }

.field-wrap .field { padding-inline-end: 74px; }

.auth-reveal {
  position: absolute; inset-block: 4px; inset-inline-end: 5px;
  min-width: 58px; padding-inline: 10px;
  border: 0; border-radius: 9px;
  background: rgba(var(--hair),.05); color: var(--ink-2);
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer;
}

.auth-reveal:hover { background: rgba(var(--hair),.09); color: var(--ink); }

.auth-reveal[hidden] { display: none; }

.auth-reveal[aria-pressed="false"] .auth-reveal__off,
.auth-reveal[aria-pressed="true"]  .auth-reveal__on { display: none; }

.auth-submit { margin-top: 4px; padding: 14px 20px; font-size: 15px; }

/* ============================================================
   Responsive — container-driven, accepted thresholds.
   <=900: one column, the FORM first and the pitch after it.
   <=560: compact card, so the submit action stays above the fold at 390
   even with both message regions visible.
   ============================================================ */
@container authpage (max-width: 900px) {
  .auth-inner { padding: 28px 20px 44px; max-width: 560px; }
  .auth-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 26px; }
  .auth-card { order: 1; }
  .auth-pitch { order: 2; padding-inline: 4px; }
  .auth-pitch__title { font-size: 24px; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
  .auth-pitch__sub { font-size: 14px; margin-top: 10px; max-width: none; }
  .auth-pitch .eyebrow { margin-bottom: 12px; }
}

@container authpage (max-width: 560px) {
  .auth-inner { padding: 16px 14px 36px; }
  .auth-card { padding: 20px 18px; border-radius: 24px; }
  .auth-head { gap: 11px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .auth-head .brand-logo--lg { width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 11px; }
  .auth-head .brand-logo--lg::after { width: 13px; height: 13px; }
  .auth-title { font-size: 21px; }
  .auth-sub { font-size: 13.5px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .auth-msg { padding: 11px 13px; margin-bottom: 13px; border-radius: 16px; }
  .auth-msg__inner { gap: 10px; }
  .auth-msg__glyph { width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 8px; }
  .auth-form { gap: 13px; }
  /* 16px prevents the iOS focus zoom; the taller box keeps the hit target >=44px */
  .auth-form .field { font-size: 16px; padding: 13px 14px; }
  .auth-submit { padding: 15px 20px; }
  .auth-note { margin-top: 14px; }
}
</style>
